properties.title: Andy Burnham will attend COP31
properties.summary: LONDON — New U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham will attend the U.N. climate conference COP31 in Turkey this November. In his first address to the House of Commons as prime minister, Burnham directly linked the devastating floods in Nepal and China to “the climate crisis” and confirmed that he would go the summit. properties.title: Ed Miliband to attend EU foreign ministers meeting in Ireland
properties.summary: LONDON — U.K. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband is to attend a meeting of EU foreign ministers in Ireland as he pushes for closer ties with Europe. The attendance by Britain’s top diplomat at the summit, which runs Tuesday and Wednesday, is the latest sign that Miliband wants to prioritize relations with Britain’s European neighbors. properties.summary: Frank Furedi announces resignation from MCC Brussels after organisation’s staff ‘not paid in July or August’ The head of Viktor Orbán’s favourite Brussels thinktank has quit, citing unpaid wages since the change of government in Hungary. properties.title: At least eight dead and 18 missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
properties.summary: Authorities say 237 people rescued and search under way for those who remain unaccounted for At least eight people have died and 18 people are missing after a ferry carrying nearly 270 passengers and crew capsized off the coast of Turkish-occupied northern Cyprus, local authorities said. properties.title: Ratko Mladić, the ‘Butcher of Bosnia’, could not escape death. But his fascist ideas and ideology live on | Ed Vulliamy
